description: An AI business assistant for Indonesian micro-business owners and social-commerce sellers, featuring a voice-first natural language interface for tracking sales, expenses, and inventory.

theme_strategy.justification: Light mode aligns with the 'Organic & Earthy' (Archetype 1) aesthetic, creating an approachable, trustworthy, and non-intimidating environment suitable for warung owners and social sellers. It ensures high readability for financial numbers outdoors.

headings.description: A humanist sans-serif that feels friendly yet geometric and modern. Excellent for numbers and clean headings.

body.description: Clean, highly readable sans-serif that balances the geometric nature of the headings.

usage_rules.text_contrast: Always ensure text meets APCA contrast standards. Use text_main on background and surface.
usage_rules.cta: Use primary (#1B4D3E) for main buttons. Use accent_terracotta (#E05A47) for warning or critical actions.
usage_rules.cards: Surface is pure white, background is warm sand (#FDFBF7) to create a subtle depth.

responsive.container: max-w-md mx-auto w-full min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl bg-[#FDFBF7]
responsive.desktop_behavior: On desktop, the app should act as a mobile-sized container centered on the screen to preserve the mobile-first voice UX.
responsive.spacing: Use generous padding. p-6 for main container edges, gap-4 for dense widgets, gap-8 between major sections.
responsive.tap_targets: min-h-[48px] min-w-[48px] for all interactive elements

bento_grid.dashboard_metrics: grid grid-cols-2 gap-4. Primary metric (Total Sales) spans 2 cols (col-span-2). Secondary metrics (Expenses, Profit) span 1 col each.
bento_grid.card_internal: flex flex-col p-5 gap-2 items-start justify-between h-full w-full bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#EBE8E0]

voice_mic.idle: Scale 1, solid background, gentle float hover.
voice_mic.listening: Pulse animation with multiple concentric rings expanding and fading out. Mic icon bounces slightly.
voice_mic.processing: Spinning border or morphing shape to indicate AI thinking.

motion.page_transitions: Slide up and fade in for new content (`translate-y-4 opacity-0` to `translate-y-0 opacity-100` with ease-out duration 0.3s).
motion.card_feedback: On tap, slight scale down (`scale-95`) and release.

voice_hero_fab.description: Massive, floating action button for the Voice AI, anchored to the bottom center.
voice_hero_fab.styles: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-primary text-white shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(27,77,62,0.3)] flex items-center justify-center z-50
voice_hero_fab.icon: Microphone icon (Phosphor icons or Lucide), sized w-8 h-8.

ai_confirmation_card.description: A bottom sheet or modal that slides up after the user speaks, showing the extracted data before saving.
ai_confirmation_card.styles: bg-white rounded-t-3xl p-6 border-t border-[#EBE8E0] shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
ai_confirmation_card.elements: Includes a natural language summary (e.g., 'Piutang baru terdeteksi'), the structured data (Pak Budi, Rp 150.000), and two large buttons: [Simpan] (Primary) and [Edit] (Secondary/Outline).

business_brief_dashboard.elements: Greeting header, large hero metric for Today's Revenue, smaller cards for Expenses and Profit. A section for 'Rekomendasi AI' (e.g., Low stock alerts).

ai_insight_card.description: Actionable recommendations generated by the AI.
ai_insight_card.styles: bg-accent_terracotta_light border border-accent_terracotta/20 rounded-2xl p-4 flex gap-3 items-start

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React for all icons. Ensure stroke width is 2 or 2.5 for better visibility. Scale appropriately with text.

hero_mock_data_faces.description: Friendly shopkeeper in tea store, use for customer avatar 'Pak Budi'.
Person sitting at table, use for user profile picture.

empty_state_graphics.description: Warung scene. Can be used as a subtle background header image or onboarding hero image with a dark gradient overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The design must be extremely mobile-first. If viewed on desktop, render the app as a centered mobile-sized container (max-w-md) to preserve the intended UX.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard tables for the 'Business Memory'. Use stacked list cards with big typography to make it legible on mobile.
Implement the 'Tap to Talk' button as the most prominent element on the screen, floating at the bottom.
Mock the AI functionality: when the user clicks the mic, simulate a listening state for 2 seconds, then show the AI Confirmation Card with a hardcoded Indonesian text example.
Use Shadcn UI for standard components (buttons, inputs) but heavily customize them to match the 'Organic & Earthy' palette and rounded-2xl border radius.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
The UI must be entirely in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined warm background and generous padding.
Avoid simplistic gradients. Use solid colors with crisp, subtle borders.
Create depth with layered z-index hierarchy and the provided shadow utilities.
Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Use specific transitions.
Do not center-align the entire app text. Left-align text for readability, center-align the main mic button.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image URLs.
